summary: All six owner English repairs are approved exactly as written: each cited unit is a bare 贈/制贈 posthumous grant of an office (黔南節度使, 武信軍節度使, 太子太師), never a fief, and both English fields carried the identical 'enfeoffed' error. The scope is complete: the only other 'enfeoff' rendering in the chapter, s0242 追封彭城郡王, is a genuine posthumous enfeoffment and is correctly kept. The owner missed one directly changed dependency: extraction chunk 003 encoded the s0117 and s0131 grants with the predicate 'enfeoffment', which the mistranslation induced and the Chinese contradicts. The parallel s0212 grant and the four previously accepted 贈 repairs (s0021, s0053, s0074, s0097) all use 'honor'. I supply the exact minimal amendment as native claim retraction plus addition (predicate only; value, certainty, date context and evidence unchanged). The full composition was dry-run with the native applier and validators in a scratch PEOPLE_REPO_ROOT and passes. Chronology becomes natively stale only through hash pins; no dated value changes. Closure can explicitly reuse 684 prior checks and needs one re-reviewed hint set (hints-p037), which I approve.
